name: Trinkets
source:
Trish needs help! She will be having her spectacular birthday party tomorrow, but the issue is... her friends will not be attending! What happened and why won't they talk to her?!

Please come help her solve this mystery and get them to the party!

[From [url=https://jacqueline-koch.itch.io/trinkets]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
翠西需要帮助！她明天将举行盛大的生日聚会，但问题是……她的朋友不会参加！发生了什么事，他们为什么不跟她说话？！

请来帮助她解开这个谜团并让他们参加聚会！

[来自[url=https://jacqueline-koch.itch.io/trinkets]Itch.io[/url]]
